title: Unique gluing of derived maps locally in degree zero
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\tau$ be its small etale or small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, regarded as a constant sheaf. Work in $D(T_\tau,A)$, the ordinary derived category of sheaves of $A$-modules [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], with cohomology sheaves [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be a set-indexed Zariski open cover of $T$, with exact derived restrictions denoted by $|_{U_i}$ [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Let $M,N\in D(T_\tau,A)$, and assume
$$\mathcal H^a(M|_{U_i})=\mathcal H^a(N|_{U_i})=0\quad\text{for every }i\in I\text{ and }a\ne0.$$
Then $\mathcal H^a(M)=\mathcal H^a(N)=0$ for $a\ne0$, and the good-truncation maps [def-kun-truncations] induce canonical isomorphisms $M\cong\mathcal H^0(M)[0]$ and $N\cong\mathcal H^0(N)[0]$, natural in these objects and commuting with restriction. Restriction induces a bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{D(T_\tau,A)}(M,N)\xrightarrow{\sim}\left\{(a_i)\in\prod_i\operatorname{Hom}_{D((U_i)_\tau,A)}(M|_{U_i},N|_{U_i}):a_i|_{U_i\cap U_j}=a_j|_{U_i\cap U_j}\text{ for all }i,j\right\}.$$
Under the canonical degree-zero identifications this is exactly unique gluing of the $A$-module sheaf maps $\mathcal H^0(M)|_{U_i}\to\mathcal H^0(N)|_{U_i}$. In particular equality of two such global derived maps can be checked on this cover. The assertion includes the empty scheme and its empty open cover; it asserts no gluing property for arbitrary derived complexes.
